note: Files: studies/rlneurons/results/axis/math500-01/vectors.json + manifest.json (committed), studies/rlneurons/results/rln4/t1_t2_items-01/per_problem.json (committed). manifest.json has no 'model' field, so arms are identified by name and manifest 'what'/'prompt': Code 3.1 = 'code_cue' ('RL-Zero-Code 3.1, cue'), Code 3.0 = the single non-derived cue arm whose 'what' contains 'Olmo-3-7B-RL-Zero-Code (3.0)' (code30_cue). Quartiles: sort the 500 per_problem rows by t2_generated_tokens (RL-Zero-Math 3.1 plain, sample T2), ties by problem_index; cap hits kept at their stored count. Vectors aligned via problem_indices; a missing/null entry counts 0. Only ambiguity: the D<=0 rule. Main = 0 when D<=0, alt_measured = raw D_4/D (null if D=0); when D>0 alt equals main. Caveat: 'RL answer length' is a single T2 sample of the Math-RL model, not Code-RL length; the ratio is noisy when D is small (D ~ 39 problems expected).

Same files. Q4 = ranks 376-500 by t2_generated_tokens ascending, ties by problem_index. Code 3.0 = code30_cue (manifest 'what' 'Olmo-3-7B-RL-Zero-Code (3.0), cue'). Base = mean over base_cue_s0..s3 (family base_cue, prompt cue, not derived; the 4 Day-1 #3 samples of one job) of each arm's Q4 right count; derived arms base_vote4/base_tie_short are not used. Missing/null counts 0. No material ambiguity, so alt_measured = null. Refuted if measured > +1.0. Caveat: Code 3.0 ran with the 3.1 tokenizer and prompt (knowledge-0b450e), and the base is 4 samples while Code 3.0 is 1, so sampling noise in Q4 is a few problems.

Same files and arms as k=1. Q1+Q2 = the 250 problems with the lowest t2_generated_tokens (ties by problem_index), i.e. ranks 1-250. Statistic = right(code_cue) - right(code30_cue) over these 250; missing/null counts 0. No material ambiguity, so alt_measured = null. Refuted if measured > 5. Caveat: one sample per arm, so the paired difference has a noise of several problems.

Same files as k=2. Q1+Q2 as in k=3. Statistic = right(code30_cue) on these 250 minus the mean over base_cue_s0..s3 of each arm's right count on these 250; missing/null counts 0. No material ambiguity, so alt_measured = null. Refuted if measured < -0.5. Caveat: the short half is near ceiling for both models, so the differences are small and noisy; one Code 3.0 sample vs a 4-sample base mean.
